name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to get to the goal “after that,” making the order hard. The soft Precedence(has_key, at_goal) weakens this requirement. Make it hard; keep the soft Existence(at_goal), since “if you can” makes reaching the goal a preference.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(has_key) requires the commanded key pickup. The hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) preserves “after that,” while the soft Existence(at_goal) correctly treats reaching the goal as preferred.

texts: Reach the goal after acquiring the key.
